strongest_counterhypotheses: Per-read attestation queries may cost enough that a simpler online/non-indexed route dominates end-to-end latency.
schema_version is conservative and unrelated DDL may cause unnecessary full rank-index rebuilds.
Runtime fingerprinting may over-invalidate on kernel/platform changes that do not change expression-index semantics.
Single-connection transactional tests do not prove multi-connection schema race or WAL/checkpoint safety.
Token-safe SQL identity is intentionally stricter than semantic equivalence and may reject harmless alternative DDL spellings.
Physical accelerator safety does not establish EAP17 retrieval quality, downstream Frank outcome quality, or database superiority.
